name: Mike Hutchison
occupation: Undersheriff, Fremont County Sheriff's Office (County 10, Aug. 19, 2026)
background: Mike Hutchison ran in the 2026 Republican primary for Fremont County sheriff. County 10 reported that he was the undersheriff and finished second in the August 18, 2026, primary, behind John Zerga.

sources.name: County 10, Aug. 19, 2026, Longtime Fremont County resident John Zerga is the new Sheriff in town following 2026 Primary Election night
